点一下，切下一刀: Tap to make the next cut
切完了。点钞票再来一张，或换一样东西花。: All cut. Tap the note for another, or spend it on something else.
点一下钞票，切下一刀。每一刀都是供应链上的一站。: Tap the note to make the next cut. Each cut is one step up the supply chain.
同一摞钱，按最后给了谁来分。: The same stack, split by who ends up with it.
同一摞钱，按花在什么上来分。: The same stack, split by what you buy.
上下拖动或滚动，缩放这把尺子。: Drag up or down, or scroll, to zoom the ruler.
一张钞票被一刀刀切开，碎片飞向工资、利润、税和进口；一辈子的钱叠成一根柱子，伸向: A banknote is cut again and again, and the pieces fly to wages, profit, tax and imports. A lifetime of money stacks into a column that rises toward space.
